review_skip_undocumented: review the skip_undocumented function that filters undocumented members from Sphinx autodoc output
review_setup: review the setup function that connects skip_undocumented to the autodoc-skip-member event
summarize_conf: summarize the Sphinx documentation configuration including extensions, theme, and exclude patterns
refactor_exclude_patterns: refactor the exclude_patterns list to add or remove directories from Sphinx source file scanning
refactor_extensions: refactor the extensions list to enable or disable Sphinx extensions like nbsphinx
